youtube.title: Why does the same sky burn red at sunset? 🌅 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Why does the same sky that is blue at noon burn red at sunset? Air scatters blue light in every direction, but at sunset the light has to cross far more atmosphere, and the blue is scattered away. What survives is orange and red. Dust and smoke strengthen it, which is why sunsets after wildfires look unreal. Full episode on the channel.
